canonical: lexicographically smallest integer board tuple over D4; canonicalize only for source grouping and split
order: sha256('C26-source-v1|'+comma_join_canonical_board); take first100 sorted hashes within ply
cue_seed: unsigned integer from first16 hex of sha256('C26-cue-v1|'+comma_join_canonical_board)
history: reachable legal history transformed to the chosen canonical representative; stop traversal on wins/draws

primary.unit: source parent; average seeds after per-seed timing median
primary.inference: 95% percentile interval, 2000 paired parent bootstrap draws stratified by ply, seed2600923
primary.positive_gain_gate: lower endpoint >0; otherwise do not claim positive expected priced gain

secondary: all six policy comparisons at all caps
utility gain and exact regret against independent oracle
node and time savings against ALL_ACTIONS at full cap
Brier/cost calibration and within-root residual dependence
